'''Voklov Adaim''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Anomid/Legends|Anomid]] who worked as a [[Bioweapon/Legends|bioweapons]] designer during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].<ref name="Exit" /> Around [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> Adaim was arrested and [[Death/Legends|executed]] for crimes against the Anomid species; before he was executed, an agent of the Empire visited him and convinced him to share his knowledge. Despite his dislike of the Empire, Adaim agreed to share his research and materials.<ref name="Exit" />

==Behind the scenes==
Voklov Adaim was first mentioned in the Bioanalysis crewskill mission "Exit Interview," which is only available to Imperial classes in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Exit" />
